# Cal/OSHA Hazard Communication (HazCom) with GHS Training

> 2-hour online course on California's Hazard Communication Standard, Title 8 CCR Section 5194, supplemented by the 2024 federal OSHA standard 29 CFR 1910.1200. Teaches GHS hazard classification, labels, pictograms and Safety Data Sheets, plus California-only requirements. Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Standards: Title 8 CCR §5194; 29 CFR 1910.1200 (HCS 2024 update)
- Duration: 2 hours; 4 lessons plus final exam
- Credits: 0.2 CEU
- Price: $59.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats; SCORM, virtual and in-person options
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7; English and Spanish
- Training timing: at initial assignment and when a new chemical hazard is introduced; annual refresher recommended as best practice
- Prerequisites: none

## California-only requirements covered
- Director's List of Hazardous Substances
- Plain-language health risk description on SDSs
- 30-day rule for sharing revised SDS information
- Missing SDS: written inquiry to the supplier within 7 working days; copy to the Director of Industrial Relations if no response within 25 working days
- Proposition 65: following §5194 can meet Prop 65 employee warning requirements for chemicals covered by both; employers with fewer than 10 employees are not subject to Prop 65
- §5194 applies to public (state, county, city) as well as private employers

## Lessons
1. Cal/OSHA HazCom Aligned with the GHS
2. Hazard Classification
3. Hazardous Chemical Labels (pictograms, DOT labels, NFPA/HMIS differences)
4. Safety Data Sheets (all 16 sections)
